anomalies.description: A large crowd of people, many wearing dark clothing and masks, is engaged in violent unrest on a city street. Police in riot gear are present and appear to be confronting the crowd; smoke (likely from tear gas or stun grenades) is visible, and objects are being thrown. The scene shows dynamic movement, pushing, and chaotic interaction consistent with a riot.; A large crowd of protesters confronts a line of riot police in full gear; smoke (likely tear gas or stun grenades) is deployed, and the crowd appears to be pushing forward while police hold a defensive line. The scene shows sustained collective violent unrest with active engagement between groups.

A bright flash and sudden plume of smoke erupt near the left side of the frame (near streetlight), consistent with a pyrotechnic device (e.g., stun grenade or smoke canister) detonating on the ground during the confrontation.

Police line in full riot gear (helmets, shields) forms a barrier facing a dense crowd. Significant smoke/tear gas is deployed, obscuring parts of the scene. Red flares or pyrotechnics are visible near the police line. The confrontation remains intense and volatile, with no indication of de-escalation.

A second distinct explosion occurs in the center-left of the crowd at ~11.0s, producing a dense cloud of dust/smoke rising rapidly—visually distinct from the earlier smoke and consistent with another explosive device being deployed.

At least one small explosion or ignition event visible on the left side of the street (near parked bicycles) at ~40.0s, producing a bright flash and initial smoke plume; consistent with a flare or firework being deployed.

A street confrontation involving a large crowd and police, with multiple flares or incendiary devices burning on the ground, smoke in the air, and later deployment of riot police with water cannon under a bridge.

A violent street confrontation involving police in riot gear and a crowd, with red flares illuminating smoke-filled streets; officers are seen advancing and engaging with individuals amid dense smoke and firelight.
Physical altercations between police officers and individuals on the ground and on a sloped structure, including grappling and pushing, visible in close proximity during the riot.

A group of individuals on a graffiti-covered staircase ignite and deploy red flares, creating intense smoke and light; others are present on the stairs and below, suggesting coordinated unrest.; Large formation of riot police in full gear (helmets, shields, green markings) advances rapidly down a street amid smoke and debris; some officers appear to be deploying or reacting to projectiles or tear gas.

A large group of riot police in full protective gear forms a tight line facing a crowd, with armored vehicles and debris present; the scene shows sustained collective violent unrest with confrontation between authorities and protesters.

A red protest cutout sign is displayed on a building facade during ongoing unrest; while the sign itself is static, it appears in context of the continuing riot scene with crowds and police presence visible in prior frames, indicating sustained protest activity.
